title: 第916章 圈套第915章 墙头草
lines: 面对双方的争执，刘玉陷入深深的沉默。
在不清楚吴谦此去用意之前，他也不敢轻率决定。
就怕像高泰魏说的那样，这边刚开始强攻，赵真襄和吴谦便随之而动。
不过刘玉最怕的，还不是他们趁乱逃跑。
而是怕二人趁机出手，来一出背后偷袭，擒贼先擒王！
要知道，赵真襄可没怎么出过手，几乎还是全盛状态。
虽然在赵曜敬那，赵真襄一个返虚境四重，显得不怎么有实力。
但真扔到他身边这群元婴境的废物堆里，照样是砍下皇上狗头，如探囊取物。
龙命攸关，刘玉不敢拼。
所以也不敢让阴傀大军离的太远。
只是在拼命的思考，想吴谦到底是去干什么了！
吴谦当然在干大事！
或者说，做好一切准备，挨干……
到了云层之上后，吴谦立即便露出真实嘴脸。
拿眼睛不断瞟向赵真如那张俏脸。
虽然有面罩覆盖，但飞行中偶尔略过的春风，仍然能让他惊鸿一瞥。
那精致完美的轮廓，虽只窥见半隅，但也可见一斑。
吴谦这么下流的人，都生出只可远观，不能亵玩的敬畏感。
这让吴谦歹意更盛的同时，也生出一丝受挫感，大骂自己没出息。
“肯定是伤的太重，才有些色心不足，咱家怎么可能只看呢！”
也许是情不自禁，也可能是为自己壮胆。
在赵真襄找到一处地方，停下脚步时，吴谦竟无视身体的疼痛，鬼使神差凑了上去。
想要用蜻蜓点水的一吻，来拉开此次修炼历程的序幕。
赵真襄一直都在防着他，见状直接一个耳光就甩了过去。
「啪」的一声，在毫无障碍的空旷天际传出老远。
没想到第一声啪，竟先响到脸上。
就算声音再像，也不行啊！
吴谦当即恼羞成怒，大喊道，
“不疗了，你敢打咱家，咱家不活了，这就死给你看！”
说着便要挣脱赵真襄的束缚，来一个自由落体投胎。
没想到吴谦玩真的，赵真襄正芳心大乱，毫无防备下一个不慎，差点让吴谦得逞。
content_en:
Faced with the dispute between the two parties, Liu Yu fell into deep silence.
He didn't dare to make a rash decision before he knew Wu Qian's intentions.
Just like Gao Taiwei said, as soon as the attack started, Zhao Zhenxiang and Wu Qian followed suit.
But what Liu Yu was most afraid of was not that they could take advantage of the chaos and escape.
But he was afraid that the two of them would take the opportunity to attack from behind and capture the thief first!
You know, Zhao Zhenxiang has not made many moves, and is almost at his peak.
Although in Zhao Yaojing's case, Zhao Zhenxiang was at the fourth level of the Return to Void Realm, so he didn't seem to have much strength.
But if he really threw it into the garbage pile of the Nascent Soul Realm around him, he would still cut off the emperor's dog's head, just like picking something out of a bag.
The dragon's life was at stake, and Liu Yu didn't dare to fight.
Therefore, we don’t dare to let the Yin Puppet army stay too far away.
I was just thinking hard, wondering what Wu Qian was doing!
Of course Wu Qian is doing big things!
In other words, be prepared for everything and get fucked...
After arriving above the clouds, Wu Qian immediately revealed his true face.
He kept glancing at Zhao Zhenru's pretty face with his eyes.
Even though he was covered by a mask, the spring breeze that occasionally passed by during the flight could still give him a startling glimpse.
Although only half of the exquisite and perfect outline can be seen, it can still be seen.
A person as low as Wu Qian has a sense of awe that he can only watch from a distance and not play with.
This made Wu Qian even more malicious, and at the same time he also felt a sense of frustration and cursed himself for being hopeless.
"It must be that the injury was too serious and that's why we are a little lustful. How could our family just watch it!"
Maybe it’s because I can’t help myself, or maybe I’m emboldening myself.
When Zhao Zhenxiang found a place and stopped, Wu Qian ignored the pain in his body and moved closer by accident.
I want to kick off this cultivation process with a kiss like a dragonfly.
Zhao Zhenxiang had always been on guard against him, and when he saw this, he slapped him in the face.
A "pop" sound was heard far away in the empty sky without any obstacles.
Unexpectedly, the first snap hit my face first.
No matter how similar the sounds are, it still won’t work!
Wu Qian immediately became angry and shouted,
"Without treatment, if you dare to hit our family, our family will no longer be able to survive, and I will die for you!"
As he said this, he wanted to break free from Zhao Zhenxiang's shackles and undergo a free fall and reincarnation.
Unexpectedly, Wu Qian was serious, Zhao Zhenxiang was in a state of confusion, and she was unprepared for the next mistake, which almost allowed Wu Qian to succeed.
